title: Extraction of bacterial DNA using ChargeSwitch gDNA Mini Bacteria kit on KingFisher Flex robot
author: Leyi Wang
materials: Install script of ChargeSwitch gDNA Mini Bacteria kit on KingFisher Flex by requesting the script through ThermoFisher and installing it using BindIt software
Select the right script/method and then click start.

steps.title: Grow bacterial culture
steps.instruction: If using broth, pick a single colony and inoculate 5 mL Trypticase Soy Broth (TSB); incubate overnight at 37 °C without shaking. If using colonies from a plate, proceed to step 2.

steps.title: Lyse cells and resuspend
steps.instruction: Take 0.4 mL of the overnight broth culture, centrifuge 4 min at 8000 rpm, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 100 µL Resuspension Buffer (R4) containing RNase A. Add 5 µL lysozyme solution (50 mg/mL), vortex to mix. Store the RNase A‑containing R4 buffer at 4 °C until use. For colony samples, scoop 3 colonies directly into 100 µL R4 with RNase A, add 5 µL lysozyme, and vortex.

steps.title: Load sample plate
steps.instruction: Transfer each prepared resuspension mixture (from step 2) into the wells of a 2.4 mL 96‑deep‑well Sample plate.

steps.title: Prepare elution plate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Elution Buffer to every well of a 0.5 mL 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Prepare wash plates
steps.instruction: For each of three 2.4 mL 96‑deep‑well plates (Wash Plate 1, 2, 3), add 650 µL Wash Buffer (W12) to every well.

steps.title: Load robot consumables
steps.instruction: Place the 0.5 mL 96‑well plate containing the tip comb onto the robot, then load the Elution Plate, followed by Wash Plate 1, Wash Plate 2, and Wash Plate 3 (one by one). Finally load the Sample Plate; the instrument will begin processing automatically.

steps.title: Start robot and prepare lysis premix
steps.instruction: While the instrument processes the Sample Plate, prepare a premix of 500 µL Lysis Buffer (L14) and 10 µL Proteinase K solution.

steps.title: First pause: add lysis mix
steps.instruction: After 10 min of processing the instrument pauses. Remove the Sample Plate, add 500 µL of the Lysis Buffer/Proteinase K premix to each well, then return the plate to the robot and click Start.

steps.title: Second pause: add beads and binding buffer
steps.instruction: After another 10 min the instrument pauses again. Remove the Sample Plate, add 40 µL ChargeSwitch Magnetic Beads and 300 µL Binding Buffer (B8) to each well, reload the plate, and click Start. The robot will complete the remaining steps automatically.

steps.title: Complete run and collect DNA
steps.instruction: Allow the instrument to finish the protocol. Once complete, retrieve the Elution Plate containing purified bacterial gDNA.
